default: (a) a {@filter martial weapon|items|source=phb|category=basic|type=martial weapon} or (b) two {@filter simple weapons|items|type=simple weapon}

classFeature.name: Spellcasting
entries: You are a full caster using Charisma as your spellcasting ability.
You know 2 cantrips at 1st level and learn more as you level.
You know 2 spells at 1st level and gain more as shown in the class table.
You prepare additional spells at certain levels, and can swap known spells when you gain a level.
You can cast known spells using your available spell slots. You regain slots after a long rest.
You can cast spells with the ritual tag if you know them.
You can use an arcane focus as a spellcasting focus.
Spell Save DC = 8 + proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier
Spell Attack Modifier = proficiency bonus + Charisma modifier

classFeature.name: Necrotic Suffusion
entries: As an action, target one creature within 15 feet. If it's an undead you control, it regains HP equal to 1d8 + Charisma modifier.
Otherwise, it must make a Constitution saving throw or take necrotic damage equal to 1d8 + Charisma modifier.
Uses = Charisma modifier (min 1), recharges on long rest.
Damage/healing increases at 5th (2d8), 11th (3d8), and 17th level (4d8).

classFeature.name: Life on Demand
entries: As an action, touch a willing creature. It expends a Hit Die and adds your Charisma modifier.
It regains HP equal to the result (minimum 1).
Uses = Charisma modifier (min 1), recharges on long rest.

classFeature.name: Unlocked Spells
entries: You always have the following spells prepared:
- 2nd: spare the dying, cure wounds, life sap
- 3rd: lesser restoration, aid
- 5th: aura of vitality, beacon of hope
- 7th: aura of life, aura of purity
- 9th: greater restoration, mass cure wounds
These do not count against your spells known.

classFeature.name: Soul Harvest
entries: When you or your undead reduce a creature to 0 HP, you can use your reaction to gain temporary HP equal to your Necromancer level + that creature's Constitution modifier (min 1).

classFeature.name: Spontaneous Unburial
entries: You always know animate dead. It doesn't count against your spells known.
You can cast it as an action. You don't need a visible corpse—one is summoned from a graveyard, battlefield, etc.

classFeature.name: Deliverer
entries: When a creature within 30 feet is hit by a critical hit, use your reaction to turn it into a normal hit. Cancel any special effects.
Uses = Charisma modifier (min 1), recharges on long rest.

classFeature.name: Aura of Wellbeing
entries: Undead that start their turn within 10 feet gain temporary HP = 1d6 + Charisma modifier.
Creatures within 10 feet who are at or below half HP also gain this.

classFeature.name: Animate Major Undead
entries: You may animate a Huge or smaller CR 5 or lower humanoid, beast, or monstrosity.
It becomes a Major Undead with either Skeletal or Zombified template.
You can control only one Major Undead at a time.

classFeature.name: Master of Mending
entries: When healing with a spell or class feature, use the maximum value for each die instead of rolling.

classFeature.name: Animate Major Undead Improvement
entries: You may now animate CR 8 or lower beasts, humanoids, monstrosities, or giants.

classFeature.name: Animate Major Undead Improvement
entries: You may now animate CR 12 or lower beasts, humanoids, monstrosities, giants, dragons, or aberrations.
You retain control until it drops to 0 HP or you animate another.

classFeature.name: Macabre
entries: You gain immunity to charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, and poisoned.
You stop aging naturally.
You gain advantage on Charisma checks vs undead, and they have disadvantage on saves vs your Necromancer spells.
Mindless undead are indifferent to you unless harmed.

classFeature.name: Ability Score Improvement
entries: When you reach 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th, or 19th level, increase one ability score by 2, or two scores by 1. You can't raise a score above 20 using this feature.
